verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is marketing copy. Rippling says it provisions or revokes access based on risk signals and company policy, and that it enforces custom security policies using user and device attributes. Dynamic rules also govern group access. None of these describe conditional access evaluated at sign-in, so the story's core is only implied. Missing for 10: network/IP-based conditions, location-based conditions, per-app conditional sign-in policies, device-posture checks gating authentication, detailed first-party docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
